record.dic_text:
04316 Miyka' {mee-kaw'}

04318 的變異型; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Micha 4, Micah 1; 5

米迦 = "有誰像神"
1) 米非波設的兒子 (#撒下 9:12|)
2) 一位在與尼希米所訂的公約上簽名的利末人(#尼 10:11|)
3) 歌轄的利未人瑪他尼的父親, 亞薩的子孫 (#尼 11:17,22|)
record.edic_text:
04316 Miyka' {mee-kaw'}

a variation for 04318;; n pr m

AV - Micha 4, Micah 1; 5

Micha = "who is like God"
1) son of Mephibosheth
2) a Levite who signed the covenant with Nehemiah
3) father of Mattaniah, a Gershonite Levite and descendant of Asaph
